author: Limpeh
body:
IGN: iAM_Enrico

Reason for ban: Hacking - Flying

Staff member who took action: AuraMC_

Reason:
First of all, I completely admit to using fly to abuse players. 
I guess I was just not thinking, I didn't read anything on the forums since at that time I had no idea it existed therefore it led me into thinking I would just receive a minor temp-ban as I didn't use it to win games or kill players.

Reason for ban evasion:
I did use an alternate account by the name of MrPiggyfin111. As I said earlier I didn't know of the Avicus forums at that time which led me to believe playing on a friend's account (I suppose you could call it an alt) was allowed. I chose to assume since in theory it does disable your main account as a warning if you do have a friend's account or alt. I completely understand if I don't get unbanned at all as my complete disregard of server rules or policies directly caused the ban.

title: Infraction Apeal:

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

I admire that you acknowledge your mistakes. However, ban evasion punishments are non-negotiable in the sense that they cannot be appealed. 

This appeal is denied. 

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
